How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Full of locals

Visitors from abroad write that most tables are taken by people from Larnaca, and that this is why they came.

Book for the weekend

Guests write that Fridays and Saturdays are busy and that it is better to book a table by phone.

In the courtyard

Tables outside under the trees and lights, with fans in summer, and a room inside with wood and old tools on the walls.

A family taverna since 2008

Venari calls itself a family taverna, on its printed table covers and on Instagram, where it gives 2008 as the year it opened. It sits in a quiet street in Larnaca, with a courtyard under trees and fairy lights and wooden chairs painted with old Cypriot sayings. Guests write that the family’s children help serve, and that the evening ends with a plate of seasonal fruit and something sweet.

What guests say

Three of 217 Google reviews, all three with five stars.

“If you are looking for traditional cypriot Meze/ good this is the place, nestled in a quiet street in Larnaca this restaurant is cute and feels like you are visiting a relative and having a feast in their backyard. The loukanika was a highlight for me.”
